projection.purpose: bind the capability trace to candidate-controlled input, declarations, events, ledger and candidate_result without a self-hash cycle

canonical_serialization.unicode: every object key and string value MUST already be Unicode NFC; normalization after receipt creation is forbidden
canonical_serialization.objects: keys MUST be unique and are sorted by Unicode scalar-value lexicographic order
canonical_serialization.numbers: only integers in [-9007199254740991,9007199254740991] are admitted; floats, NaN and infinities are forbidden
canonical_serialization.literals: true, false and null use lowercase JSON spelling
canonical_serialization.strings: ensure_ascii=false JSON escaping; quotation mark, reverse solidus and U+0000..U+001F are escaped
canonical_serialization.whitespace: no insignificant whitespace; separators are comma and colon

trace_binding.artifact_snapshot_rule: hash, parse and use MUST operate on the same immutable in-memory byte snapshot; reopening a path after hashing is forbidden
